user.title: Connect to i-Vent Cloud
user.description: Enter the API key from your i-Vent account and the location ID (loc_id). The location ID can be found in the i-Vent app.

data_description.api_key: Bearer token used to authenticate against the i-Vent cloud
data_description.base_url: Leave as default unless the i-Vent cloud uses a different host, e.g. for testing against a mock server

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with i-Vent Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for location {loc_id} is no longer valid. Enter a new API key.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the i-Vent cloud
error.invalid_location: Location not found - verify the loc_id. Tip: the i-Vent app calls /api/v1/live/{loc_id}/info, so the loc_id can be seen in the app's network requests (e.g. via a proxy) or in the app's location settings

add_schedule.name: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Adds a weekly schedule item to an i-Vent ventilation group.

device_id.name: Group
device_id.description: The i-Vent group (or a device of the group) to add the schedule to.

hour.name: Hour
hour.description: Hour (0-23) at which the schedule fires.

minute.name: Minute
minute.description: Minute (0-59) at which the schedule fires.

work_mode.name: Work mode
work_mode.description: Work mode the group switches to.

special_mode.name: Special mode
special_mode.description: Special mode the group switches to.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the new schedule item is enabled.

remove_schedule.name: Remove schedule
remove_schedule.description: Removes a schedule item from an i-Vent ventilation group.

device_id.name: Group
device_id.description: The i-Vent group (or a device of the group) to remove the schedule from.

schedule_id.name: Schedule ID
schedule_id.description: The schedule_id of the schedule item to remove (see the schedule entity unique IDs).
